class.name: ModelRenderingBackend
class.brief_description: What [ModelRenderingServer] forwards the drawing of a model to.
class.description: The renderer of one kind of models, registered by its name with [method ModelRenderingServer.backend_register]. It loads a model of its own by its file, and places, poses, lights and picks its instances by RID. Every instance it makes is announced by [signal instance_created] - also one it makes for itself, outside the server - so that the server forwards the instance's calls to it.

method.name: get_priority
method.description: How well it draws against the other backends, the higher the better; 1.0 unless the backend gives its own. A model is still drawn by the backend that names it.

method.name: instance_attach_object_instance_id
method.description: The [Node3D], by instance id, that [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build their node tree under. [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instances report it as their owner (e.g. for picking in the editor). [code]0[/code] detaches it. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_attach_signal_head
method.description: The [param instance] draws the [SignallingServer] signal head's lights: its lamps follow [signal SignallingServer.signal_head_light_switched], it gives the signal head its light count once built, and frees the signal head when it is freed. An instance draws one signal head at most.

method.name: instance_build
method.description: Builds (or rebuilds) the content of the [param instance]; [signal instance_built] when done.

method.name: instance_create
method.description: Creates an empty instance; set it up with the [code]instance_set_*[/code] methods and [method instance_attach_object_instance_id], then call [method instance_build]. [param instance_kind] says what the placement is, in the words a [code].scn[/code] uses for it. It is given here rather than through a setter because it cannot be changed once the instance is built: the smoke density it selects is baked into every particle emitter of the model - its process material, its particle budget and its spawn rate. A client that has to change it frees the instance and creates it again.

method.name: instance_free
method.description: Frees the [param instance] with its [RenderingServer] instances or generated nodes.

method.name: instance_get_aabb
method.description: The bounds of every mesh of the model, in the model's space.

method.name: instance_get_part_transform
method.description: The part's transform in the model, through every parent, without any pose.

method.name: instance_get_transform
method.description: Where the instance stands in its scenario.

method.name: instance_has_light
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the model of [param instance] has the light named [param light].

method.name: instance_has_part
method.description: Whether the model has the part.

method.name: instance_intersect_segment
method.description: Where the segment [param from]..[param to] (world space) first meets the meshes of the instance: [code]{position, distance}[/code], the distance measured from [param from]. Empty when it misses, or when the instance is hidden or not built (not streamed in).

method.name: instance_register
method.description: Registers a placement of the model of [param name] for streaming instead of building it right away. Nothing is loaded or built until [SceneryStreamingServer]'s camera comes within [param range_end] of the chunk the [param transform] falls into; the instance is cleared again when the camera leaves. [param range_end] of [code]0[/code] (a scenery node that declares no range) means the global draw distance. Without a streaming camera a registered instance is never built. The backend emits [signal instance_created] for it. Free it with [method instance_free] like any other instance.

method.name: instance_set_emission_energy
method.description: The self-illumination energy of every emissive material of the instance.

method.name: instance_set_instancer
method.description: Builds the instance again with another instancer, keeping the RID and everything set on it.

method.name: instance_set_lights_dimmed
method.description: Light name to dimmed: a dimmed light shows its "_xon" part instead of "_on" when it has one, and its spotlight ([constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_NODES]) shines at [param multiplier] of its energy.

method.name: instance_set_lights_state
method.description: Light name to enabled state; shows the "on" or the "off" parts of the model's lights (and the spotlights of [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_NODES]).

method.name: instance_set_material_overlay
method.description: Draws [param material] over every part of the instance (an outline, a tint); [code]null[/code] for none. Kept while the instance is streamed out and in again.

method.name: instance_set_node_transform
method.description: Where the model sits in the attached node - a node tree built under it is placed there.

method.name: instance_set_options
method.description: Material lookup path and skins, parts excluded from rendering, forced alpha blending and the largest texture size its materials load, [code]0[/code] for the backend's own limit (see [code]ResourceInstance[/code]). Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_part_emission_energy
method.description: The self-illumination energy of a part, by name, and of everything under it, kept across rebuilds; below 0 gives it the instance's own again - one cab of a low-poly interior lit by its cab light.

method.name: instance_set_part_material_override
method.description: Draws a part, by name, with [param material] instead of its own.

method.name: instance_set_part_poses
method.description: Poses parts, by name, on top of their own transform, kept across rebuilds.

method.name: instance_set_part_visible
method.description: Shows or hides a part, by name, kept across rebuilds.

method.name: instance_set_scenario
method.description: Scenario of an [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: instance_set_transform
method.description: Global transform of an [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance. A node tree follows its attached node instead.

method.name: instance_set_visible
method.description: Visibility of an [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: material_preload
method.description: Reads the files of the model's materials - their [code].mat[/code] and their textures' images - on the calling thread, through the material preloader ([method material_set_preloader]). What it returns holds them; the build that makes the materials keeps it until it is done, so the main thread reads no file.

method.name: model_load
method.description: The model of the name, loaded once and shared by every instance of it; the backend finds its file by the name.

method.name: signal_head_get_instance
method.description: The instance of this backend's the signal head is attached to; an empty [RID] for none.

signal.name: instance_built
signal.description: [param instance] was built - its model, and so its lights, are known from now on.

signal.name: instance_created
signal.description: Emitted as the backend makes the [param instance], before anything is set on it.

signal.name: instance_freed
signal.description: [param instance] was freed, so whatever refers to it can let go.
